images: photos/site_001.jpg .. site_044.jpg, in the order they were taken on one loop through the hall
camera: one full-frame digital SLR with a wide-angle lens at one fixed focal setting, on a tripod
lens_distortion: removed: the images follow the pinhole model with square pixels
intrinsics: not recorded (the same camera and setting for every photo)
orientation: a few frames were shot with the camera turned on its side; they are stored as shot, so every file has the same width and height
metadata: none: the files carry no EXIF data
pixel_convention: OpenCV: (u, v) = (column, row); (0, 0) is the centre of the top-left pixel
